done_when: Each check runs once per pull request, and the live starter tests still run every night.
why: Pull requests print the net-line count in two places: the net-lines job in .github/workflows/forge-next.yml and the pull request size step in .github/workflows/forge.yml. The Windows installer test runs in its own windows-installers job and again in the Windows platform groups, but only for pull requests that change non-test code. Removing the job also drops the only Windows check on test-only pull requests that touch no platform test. Starter smoke's live tests skip unless FORGE_STARTER_LIVE is set, and the nightly full run in forge.yml does not set it, so moving them to nightly needs that variable set too.
